verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API v2, Postman quickstarts, personal access tokens and an official hosted MCP server, but nothing shows an official Productboard command-line tool. The API and MCP server are adjacent building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit. A CLI is a fair axis for a SaaS platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
